beats.intro: Chapter forty-six. [[sub]]Function notation is a short way to name a function and say what goes into it.
beats.notation: Here's a function written in function notation. [[name]]The letter f is the name of the function. [[input]]The x inside the parentheses is the input. [[rule]]The right side is the rule that turns the input into the output. [[read]]Read it as f of x. [[warn]]It does not mean f times x. [[mach]]Think of f as a machine: [[in]]an input x goes in, [[out]]and the output, f of x, comes out. [[other]]Any letter can name a function: g of x, or h of t, work the same way.
beats.q1: Quick check. What does f of three mean?
beats.eval: Evaluating a function means finding the output for a given input. [[ask]]Find f of three. [[sub]]Replace every x in the rule with three. [[calc]]Two times three is six, [[ans]]and six minus one is five. So f of three equals five. [[mach]]In the machine, three goes in and five comes out.
beats.graph: Every input and output pair is a point on the graph of the function. [[pt]]f of three equals five means the point three, five is on the graph. [[more]]Other inputs give other points, [[line]]and together they draw the graph of f. [[read]]You can read values off the graph, too. Go to x equals zero, [[down]]and the graph is at negative one, so f of zero is negative one.
beats.q2: Quick check. Pick a point on the graph.
beats.expr: The input can be an expression. [[ask]]Find f of a plus two. [[sub]]Put a plus two, in parentheses, everywhere x was. [[dist]]Distribute the two: two a plus four, [[comb]]then combine like terms: two a plus three. [[ans]]So f of a plus two equals two a plus three.
beats.solve: Function notation can also ask the reverse question. [[ask]]For what input does f of x equal seven? [[set]]Set the rule equal to seven: two x minus one equals seven. [[add]]Add one to both sides: two x equals eight. [[div]]Divide by two: x equals four. [[chk]]Check: f of four is eight minus one, which is seven. [[graph]]On the graph, the height seven meets the line right above x equals four.
beats.wrap: To sum up. [[w1]]f of x names the output of the function f for the input x. It's not multiplication. [[w2]]To evaluate, replace every x with the input and calculate. [[w3]]Each pair, x and f of x, is a point on the graph. [[w4]]To find an input, set the rule equal to the output and solve. [[end]]Now try the chapter practice.
beats.final3: Last one. The input is an expression.
beats.finish: Well done. That's the end of chapter forty-six, function notation.
